name: Aibheaeg

attributes.attribute: Fairy Queen or goddess of Donegal

sources: Logan, Patrick. The Holy Wells of Ireland. (Gerrards Cross: Colin Smyth, 1980), 67.
Monaghan, Patricia. O Mother Sun: A New View of the Cosmic Feminine. Freedom, Calif.: The Crossing Press, 1994, 70.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aibheaeg was an Irish divinity or fairy. She was the Fairy Queen or goddess of Donegal, worshiped at a well of fire. The water of the well was held to cure toothache. The petitioner left a white stone as a substitute for the tooth. The link of wells with toothache was less common than their link with the healing of eye diseases.

okr.objective: Record Aibheaeg, the Fairy Queen or goddess of Donegal.
key_results: Show her well of fire and its cure for toothache.
